name: Souldate
source:
On a search for love, you download an app, Soulmate, that guarantees your soulmate on the first date... Although, you realize the truth behind the app when you go on your first Souldate!

[From [url=https://scoutscoot.itch.io/souldate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了寻找爱情，你下载了名为Soulmate的应用。它保证让你在第一次约会就遇见灵魂伴侣……不过，等你赴约，参加第一次“Souldate”时，才发现了这款应用背后的真相！

[摘自[url=https://scoutscoot.itch.io/souldate]Itch.io[/url]]
